order_of_operations: 30 items frozen from the blind file before any detector output was inspected
blind CSV built with NO detector flag, NO gold, NO accuracy
manual labels assigned against the frozen rubric and written to _FILLED.csv
only then was earlycand-v1 run and compared
outcome: PASS -- detector positives (29) exceed the frozen minimum of 10, so precision is decidable on this sample; earlycand-v1 may be used as an EXPLORATORY timing readout on this task.
verdict_scope: EXPLORATORY only: outside the Holm family.
early_candidate is an OUTCOME of alpha, so stratifying accuracy on it is post-treatment stratification -- consistent-with evidence, never mediation.
The detector was NOT re-tuned; it is the frozen earlycand-v1 imported unchanged.

critical_limitation.note: The alpha=0 base rate is at CEILING on both models (.952 / 1.000). The audit establishes that the detector reads this task correctly, but a near-saturated baseline leaves almost no headroom for the rate to RISE, so only a DECREASE under alpha is measurable. A flat or unchanged rate must NOT be read as 'alpha does not move answer-formation timing' -- it is the same baseline-ceiling problem the stage-0 accuracy gate exists to exclude, here reappearing in the timing readout rather than in accuracy. This limitation is recorded BEFORE any steered cell was generated.

single_annotator: Labels come from one annotator against the frozen rubric. The 29/30 pattern is morphologically stark (a bare standalone number on line 1 versus a reasoning opening), so it is unlikely to be annotator-sensitive, but no inter-rater agreement was measured.
